items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: We didn’t expect him to pick up the mute for his trumpet. Because he didn’t rehearse it that way when we were going over the song.

ctx.x: I liked a moment that happened on — I think it was the tune “I Really Love You” from the “Truth According to Ruthie Foster.” Wayne Jackson and this little muted trumpet thing. It just sounded so spontaneous.

Yeah. I think it was. We didn’t expect him to pick up the mute for his trumpet. Because he didn’t rehearse it that way when we were going over the song. And Wayne was one of those people where he showed up, and I didn’t realize this: these guys, the Memphis Horns is what you’re talking about, Wayne Jackson and the Memphis Horns, they didn’t show up with music at all. And I thought that was really odd coming from a girl who — you know I went to school for music and that’s what horn players do usually when they…
song. And it’s perfect, absolutely perfect how that turned out. Genius. Loved working with Wayne.
